caption: The drawing shows a single object that appears to be a belt or strap, predominantly white in color. On the upper part of the object, there is a section decorated with embroidered floral designs, consisting of a central pink flower with multiple green leaves and stems, along with several smaller white flowers. The rest of the strap is plain with a subtle texture, and the left end features a rectangular, brownish buckle, while the right end shows another brown section and a fastener. The background of the drawing is a uniform light beige color without any additional objects or patterns. The object is drawn diagonally from the lower left to the upper right.
title: Wedding Garters
